answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the knoll to sunk effort, uses the shale as an corroborating signal, then requires a haven before any payout.
